environment.hardware: Linux-6.18.44-x86_64-with-glibc2.41; CPU only; no imposed memory or affinity cap

mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact bounded checks of evidence, correction memory, calibration, fixed-model output agreement, common observable quotients, linear initialization and likelihood-profile migration.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Integers, finite sets, exact fractions.Fraction and F2
mathematics.conventions: New matrix code is row-major. The retained first-draft helper uses columns. Words execute in chronological order. One candidate model is fixed per execution; switching is a separate control. No posterior is assigned to a zero-probability report.

bounds.finite_grounding: All one-operation machines on n=1,2,3 states, all binary output labels, all evidence partitions; continuation words through n+1.
bounds.nondestructive_revision: Three immutable cases; every binary target, every retained partition, every ordered pair of binary tests; all test subsets and depth-two adaptive trees.
bounds.destructive_and_reset_controls: Three one-shot cases with two destructive tests, depths 0..5; eight sensor worlds (s,theta,k).
bounds.correction_memory: All 256 candidate subsets of eight sensor worlds; theta partition, target s; all four atom-union observations, sixteen correction profiles, and their separators.
bounds.noisy_identification: Two Bernoulli models p=1/4,3/4; exact strings through length seven and odd majority errors through length nineteen.
bounds.ambiguity_radius: All nonempty subsets of {-1,0,1}^2, midpoint radius versus exact half-grid minimax; one explicit compression union.
bounds.calibrated_continuation: All two-operator restrictions from a one-dimensional subspace of F2^2; all 16 completions of each pair, all four initial vectors and word lengths through three. A three-dimensional escape example is also exhausted.
bounds.approximate_continuation: Exact rational 2x2 operators, calibrated line span(e1), induced l1 norms, powers through six. Explicit ambient-growth negative control.
bounds.pair_closure_one_action: Every ordered pair of 2x2 matrices over F2, every scalar linear observation including zero, every initial vector; direct words of lengths 0..4.
bounds.pair_closure_two_actions: Two fixed models with two actions chosen from four explicit 2x2 F2 matrices; all 256 families, all four scalar observations and four initial vectors; words through length four.
bounds.unrestricted_calibration_no_enlargement: V=F2^2; U=span(e1); every possible calibrated first column, all four linear completions, every nonzero scalar Q and every vector; horizons one through four.
bounds.whole_space_quotient: Every pair of 2x2 F2 matrices; all scalar outputs; uncertainty closure versus all initial-condition fixed-model agreement and quotient kernel invariance.
bounds.fixed_model_and_hidden_return_controls: Exact rational two-dimensional fixed nilpotent models, forbidden switching, and invisible one-step uncertainty returning at step two; steps zero through eight.
bounds.minimal_linear_initialization: Every 2x2 F2 single-action map and scalar observation; five initial subspaces and four scalar record maps; kernel criterion versus direct output signatures through length four. Two rational worked realizations.
bounds.likelihood_profile_correction: Eight sensor worlds with nuisance bit, two theta-dependent likelihood profiles, target s. All 35 quarter-grid joint priors placed in either nuisance slice; every binary report word through length three.
bounds.probability_memory_migration: All 15 partitions of four worlds as old and new joint-cell partitions; point masses as separating witnesses, and all 35 quarter-grid priors for every admissible aggregation.
bounds.noisy_association_and_scope_controls: Opposite correlation priors with equal marginals, one noisy reference with probabilities 1/4 and 3/4, sequences of zero through eight matching reports, and a newly added likelihood splitting an old cell.

non_claims: No universal proof by finite enumeration.
No Lean or independent scientific replication.

checks: Every subprocess completed within its declared twenty-second wall limit.
All pinned input hashes agree before and after execution.
Ten predecessor statement/proof pairs and two reference programs preserved.
result: Implementation and finite assertions verified within the recorded domains.
residual_risks: Proofs and checking programs are project-authored, not independent review.
Legacy-v1 manifest with extra input pins and project-local validation, not an authenticated external audit.
No repository commit, enforced memory cap, proof kernel or external execution attestation.
